profile.name: Unnamed Dracthyr
profile.epithet: Sealed in the Forbidden Reach for ten thousand years. Relearning the world one record at a time.
profile.constructNote: An archival construct of Shadowlands make, bought from a broker who asked no questions and answered fewer.

records.title: The Shadowlands
records.note: The realms where souls go after death. The construct was made there, and its memory holds more of that place than any tutor I have found.

records.title: The Sundering
records.note: The Well of Eternity tore itself apart and the land broke with it. The coastlines I remember flying over are gone.

records.title: Brokers
records.note: Cloaked merchants who trade between worlds. One sold me this construct and would not say where it came from.

records.title: Neltharion
records.note: I remember the Earth-Warder, Aspect of the black flight, who made us. The world now calls him Deathwing. He went mad, broke the world a second time, and was killed.

records.title: The Horde and the Alliance
records.note: Two pacts of the younger races. They fight each other, then fight side by side when something worse arrives. I do not yet know how either began.

records.title: Valdrakken
records.note: City of the dragonflights on the Dragon Isles. The first place I saw dracthyr welcomed by the other flights, more or less.

records.title: Draconic speech
records.note: The old tongue of dragons. I still speak it better than the trade language everyone here uses.

records.title: Humans
records.note: Short-lived and everywhere. Where did they come from? Everyone assumes I already know.

records.title: The Scourge
records.note: Mentioned in passing, always followed by a pause. Undead armies of some kind. I need the whole account.
